title: Event
description: Event layer (spec-v1.0: 'State transition'). A record that an occurrence took place. No inference: an Event records what occurred and when, never why.

id.description: Identifier of this Event, unique within the record stream.

sequence.description: Position of this Event in the record stream. Strictly increasing across the stream (guarantee G1: event ordering).

occurred_at.description: Time of the occurrence (RFC 3339, UTC 'Z' suffix). Non-decreasing across the stream in sequence order.

intent_ref.description: Id of the Intent this Event occurred for, if any. Within a Canonical Record it must equal intent.id.
